claim_boundary: Each result verifies that one exact public statement appeared in the fetched ICH E6(R3) Guideline for Good Clinical Practice bytes on 2026-08-11. It does not independently establish the statement's underlying real-world truth.
review_design: retrospective deterministic source-publication audit; not preregistered, not an independent fact-check, and not an independent reproduction
source_name: ICH E6(R3) Guideline for Good Clinical Practice
selection_method: Deterministic sentence extraction with minimum length and prose-quality filters, signal scoring, duplicate removal, and per-page concentration limits.
verification_rule: Extract PDF text, compare quote and extracted text after removing layout whitespace and hyphens, require every quote once or more, and require the complete fetched PDF SHA-256 to match.

records.public_claim_text: Clinical trials conducted in accordance with this standard will help to assure that the rights, safety and well-being of trial participants are protected; that the conduct is consistent with the principles that have their origin in the Declaration of Helsinki; and that the clinical trial results are reliable.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Clinical trials conducted in accordance with this standard will help to assure that the rights, safety and well-being of trial participants are protected; that the conduct is consistent with the principles that have their origin in the Declaration of Helsinki; and that the clinical trial results are reliable.

records.public_claim_text: Guideline Scope This guideline applies to interventional clinical trials of investigational products1 that are intended to be submitted to regulatory authorities.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Guideline Scope This guideline applies to interventional clinical trials of investigational products1 that are intended to be submitted to regulatory authorities.

records.public_claim_text: The principles outlined in this guideline may be satisfied using differing approaches and should be applied to fit the intended purpose of the clinical trial.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: The principles outlined in this guideline may be satisfied using differing approaches and should be applied to fit the intended purpose of the clinical trial.

records.public_claim_text: Annex 1, including its Appendices, is intended to provide information on how the Principles can be appropriately applied to clinical trials.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Annex 1, including its Appendices, is intended to provide information on how the Principles can be appropriately applied to clinical trials.

records.public_claim_text: The principles are interdependent and should be considered in their totality to assure ethical trial conduct and reliable results.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: The principles are interdependent and should be considered in their totality to assure ethical trial conduct and reliable results.

records.public_claim_text: The participant selection process should be representative of the population groups that the investigational product is intended to benefit, once authorised, to allow for generalising the results across the broader population.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: The participant selection process should be representative of the population groups that the investigational product is intended to benefit, once authorised, to allow for generalising the results across the broader population.

records.public_claim_text: For potential participants unable to provide informed consent, their legally acceptable representatives, acting in the participants’ best interest, should provide consent prior to clinical trial participation.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: For potential participants unable to provide informed consent, their legally acceptable representatives, acting in the participants’ best interest, should provide consent prior to clinical trial participation.

records.public_claim_text: In the event that a minor is a participant, assent should be collected from that minor, as appropriate, and in accordance with local regulatory requirements (see ICH E11(R1) Clinical Investigation of Medicinal Products in the Pediatric Population).
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: In the event that a minor is a participant, assent should be collected from that minor, as appropriate, and in accordance with local regulatory requirements (see ICH E11(R1) Clinical Investigation of Medicinal Products in the Pediatric Population).

records.public_claim_text: Individuals involved in a trial should be qualified by education, training and experience to perform their respective task(s).
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Individuals involved in a trial should be qualified by education, training and experience to perform their respective task(s).

records.public_claim_text: These factors are attributes of a trial that are fundamental to the protection of participants, the reliability and interpretability of the trial results and the decisions made based on those trial results.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: These factors are attributes of a trial that are fundamental to the protection of participants, the reliability and interpretability of the trial results and the decisions made based on those trial results.
